verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's own materials say it registers you in the jurisdictions that require it, and its API supports creating and tracking registration records. That makes in-product, vendor-handled registration a documented capability, though the evidence is marketing-level. Missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, explicit registration status tracking (application pending/approved), evidence of local (not just state) registrations, in-depth docs on the done-for-you registration workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, registering for a sales tax permit is handled in-product — the vendor files state and local registrations on my behalf with transparent per-registration pricing and status tracking

citations.quote: registers you in the jurisdictions that require it, and files and remits on schedule
